synonyms: I Spoiled “Quderella” Next Door and I’m Going To Give Her a Key to My House
I Ended up Giving the Key to My Home After Spoiling the Kuudere Next to Me
After spoiling the "Couderella" next door, I was given the key to my house.
synopsis: Katagiri Natsuomi, a high school student living alone for two years, has a beautiful black-haired, blue-eyed girl move into the next room. The girl, Yui, is actual nobility, and her nickname is “Cool-de-rella” because of her indifferent attitude at school. When Natsuomi finds out that Yui doesn’t want to rely on others, but is actually quite naive, he decides to help her out. This is the beginning of a sweet and tantalizing relationship between two neighbors.

synopsis: One day, listless part-timer Tamura Nana was summoned out of her room and into another world, after which her summoners declared her a saint and asked her to save their world. title: History of the Kingdom of the Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
titleRomaji: Orcsen Oukokushi: Yaban na Orc no Kuni wa, Ika ni Shite Heiwa na Elf no Kuni wo Yakiharau ni Itatta ka
titleEnglish: History of the Kingdom of the Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
titleNative: オルクセン王国史 ～野蛮なオークの国は、如何にして平和なエルフの国を焼き払うに至ったか～
synonyms: History of the Kingdom of the Orcsen - How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came To Burn Down The Peaceful Elfland
synopsis: Betrayed by their brethren, a dark elf chief must do whatever it takes to save her people-even trusting orcs. After their allies violently attack, chieftain Dineru of the dark elves commands her remaining people to flee, leading them into Orcsen, a land of orcs. Despite being enemies, Dineru and her clan are welcomed into the kingdom. Dineru makes a deal with the orc king, Gustav, asking for supplies so she can return to fight, but Gustav has other plans. Fighting alongside the dark elves, Gustav helps lead Dineru to victory and offers them a permanent home in the kingdom. Will Dineru and her people find peace, or is this the beginning of a deadly future? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

But now he has been targetted by the legendary assassin "RED", so he is hiding out as a part-time manager at a convenience store in rural Hokkaido until the situation cools down. However, the high school girl working at the convenience store, Akiko Karakohi, keeps asking Fujiyoshi about his past. Fujiyoshi suspects that she might be the assassin "RED" who is after him...? A life-threatening romantic comedy begins! (Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)
